title: Fill and submit the httpbin form

turns.prompt: Go to https://httpbin.org/forms/post and submit the form with customer name Ada, pizza size large, topping bacon, delivery time 18:30 and the comment 'eval run'. Save the JSON that the site echoes back to {D}/response.json and tell me which fields it echoed.
turns.verify:
f={D}/response.json; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no response.json; exit 0; }; sed 's/^/SHOW /' $f | head -40; python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
d=json.load(open('{D}/response.json'))
form=d.get('form',d)
s=json.dumps(form).lower()
ok='ada' in s and 'large' in s and 'bacon' in s
print('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL: fields missing in '+s[:200])
EOF
